svg.title: RA6 manual CI demos
svg.desc: Four manually triggered RA6 CI demos using ECW booking, explicit flashing and result artifacts.

g.text: ECW CI demos · one physical FPB-RA6E2
Manual dispatch only · board 23 · Zephyr fpb_ra6e2 · one shared hardware queue
Build → reserve / validate booking → configure when needed → program → verify → collect → release
01 · Blinky + camera
demo/ra6-blinky-camera
Build RA6 HEX → upload to NFS → explicit flash
Ticket-authenticated console starts 50 ms LED toggles
One authenticated MJPEG stream stays open
67 screenshots: 0, 30, …, 1980 ms over 2 seconds
Save frame sequence, age, timestamps and duplicates
02 · Hello + serial
demo/ra6-hello-serial
Build RA6 HEX → upload to NFS → explicit flash
CI job: mcu.serial_log, duration 5000 ms
Download hello.log from the job artifact ZIP
Require ≥4 consecutive numbered RA6 greetings
Preserve job metadata, results and diagnostic logs
03 · BME280 HIL · 50 samples
demo/ra6-hil-50-samples
Select BME280 → prepare → wait active (≤180 s)
Frontend-format CSV: 50 rows → 150 verified words
Upload RA6 HEX → explicit flash → ticket console
Read chip ID 0x60 and 50 T/H/P SPI samples
Compare a complete CSV cycle; stale data fails
04 · Zephyr Twister HIL
demo/ra6-zephyr-twister
GitHub: compile suite and Twister build-only check
API job: twister.run profile ci_twister_test
Trusted backend profile → Twister → pytest → RM
Flash once → identify → 5 nonce echoes → uptime
Require passed case + exit 0 + JSON/JUnit reports
Camera: 30 ms saves may repeat frames if the source is slower. Actual frame cadence is recorded.
Caller-supplied bookings are preserved. New CI bookings are released. No pull request is needed.
